items.title: Fred Radke interviewed by Monk Rowe, Hillsdale, Michigan, November 8, 2023
items.q: when I was with Harry and my dear old friend Sonny Payne, Sonny — we played really good together.

ctx.x: Let me ask you about the relationship between the lead trumpet player and the drummer?

I know, I’ve heard you ask that question, okay? Extremely important. That’s the most important — sorry saxophone players — the lead trumpet player and the drummer are the whole foundation of a band. A lead trumpet player, even in an orchestra or in the President’s band, they set the timbre for the band, the first trumpet player. They set the timbre for the orchestra or for the band. It’s extremely important that you think alike. I’ve played with some great drummers and of course when I was with Harry and my dear…
was right there, just like that. And so the lead trumpet player is laying it down, you’ve got to be right in sync with the drummer. Absolutely.
